critical_evidence.evidence: The listing and quoted Carfax summary do not mention P2440/P2442 codes, air pump or switching valve work. No scan data provided.

It is not established whether this Premium/Sport Design car has KDSS (it was an option on 2020+ Premium). If the window sticker shows no KDSS, this item becomes not applicable. If fitted, no leak or lean evidence is provided.
Described as Southern-owned (Memphis). No underside or frame photos examined here, and no inspection report.

The cluster photo shows the gear in P with the tach at 0, so the engine appears off. Amber icons are visible that look like ignition-on or seatbelt reminders, so running status cannot be judged. The seller makes no statement.

documentation.rationale: The identity half is strong: VIN decoded cleanly, window sticker in the gallery, Carfax referenced, one owner, and the odometer photo matches the latest Carfax mileage. The maintenance half is thin. Entries are mostly quick-lube oil changes, with no fluid services beyond oil and no underside or at-risk-area photos. The accident has no repair documentation.

condition.rationale: No mechanical fault is stated, but none is proven absent. Disclosed defects are cosmetic: an unrepaired rear bumper crack from the Dec 2025 impact, chips and dings, curb rash, headliner scuffs and interior wear. There is no evidence on the frame, leaks, KDSS or air injection.

price_value.rationale: The current bid of $27,300 already sits above the fair value estimate ($19,238–$24,623). That estimate is drawn from 2010–2017 comps and likely understates a 2021. Still, a reserve auction on a 2021 GX usually clears well above the current bid. Known cosmetic work and undone fluid services add to the cost.

mission_fit.rationale: It supplies what the RX 350 lacks: body-on-frame construction, low range, a locking center differential and roof rails for a rooftop tent. A low-mileage 1UR V8 is a reliable basis. Fit is held back by likely price-band pressure and a remote auction timeline.

logistics.rationale: Memphis, TN is a remote online auction closing Sept 29, with no stated inspection access before bidding. A binding bid means a PPI must be arranged in Memphis within four days. CA registration looks likely feasible but is unconfirmed.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: A one-owner, unmodified 2021 with the Sport Design package and captain's chairs is a clean spec. Atomic Silver over tan is pleasant but common. It has the older infotainment without CarPlay.

what_would_change_verdict: Up: a Memphis PPI before close showing a clean frame, dry engine, no codes and undamaged rear structure behind the bumper.
Up: the full Carfax plus receipts for any driveline fluid service, or confirmation of KDSS status and health.
Down: frame rust, rear structural damage beyond the bumper, or secondary air or valley-plate issues found on inspection.
Down: the seller declines pre-auction inspection access, leaving a binding remote bid with no PPI.
evidence.mission_note: A GX 460 genuinely adds capability the RX 350 lacks (body-on-frame, low range, locking center differential, roof rails for a rooftop tent), so it fits the utility branch on substance. Fit depends on the auction clearing near the budget band and on inspection happening before a binding bid.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes identity well: the VIN decodes to a 2021 GX 460 Premium matching the description, there is one claimed owner since April 2021, and the 67,700-mile odometer photo agrees with the latest Carfax entry quoted. The quoted Carfax shows a Dec 2025 rear impact, and the disclosed rear bumper crack and scratches indicate that damage was never repaired, with no claim or repair documentation offered. Maintenance evidence consists mostly of quick-lube oil changes, a battery and tires; no transmission, transfer case, differential, coolant or brake fluid service appears in the summary. Model-critical items remain open: frame rust on a Southern-owned car, secondary air injection status, and even whether KDSS is fitted. The cluster photo cannot confirm running warning-light status because the engine appears to be off. On price, the current $27,300 bid already exceeds the deterministic fair-value range, which is built on older model years, and it is a reserve auction likely to clear higher. PPI access before the Sept 29 close is not stated.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller through Cars & Bids today for the full Carfax PDF, a window-sticker options photo (KDSS), underside and rear-structure photos, and permission to book an independent PPI in Memphis before the Sept 29 11:39 AM PDT close.
